{{Quote|We crewed together on a Corellian rim-runner&mdash;you name it, we'd smuggle it.|Han Solo, on Katya M'Buele|<ref name="The Long Hunt" />}}
The '''Corellian rim-runner'''<ref name="The Long Hunt" /> was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Together with [[Katya M'Buele]],<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] crewed a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] rim-runner<ref name="The Long Hunt" /> [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] ship after leaving [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] service<ref name="CSWE" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
